definitions.gloss: to resound, to reverberate, to ring out, to echo loudly
definitions.explanation: For a sound to ring out loudly and spread through a space. Often used for bells, alarms, applause, or any resonant sound.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鐘|かね}→鐘：02654_kane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鳴|な}り{響|ひび}いた。
⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鳴|な}り{響|ひび}いた。

⟦{真夜中|まよなか}→真夜中：05425_mayonaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦サイレン→サイレン：26994_sairen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{町中|まちじゅう}→町中：28383_machijuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鳴|な}り{響|ひび}き、⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いて→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|さ}ました→覚ます：02057_samasu⟧。
examples.english: In the middle of the night, sirens resounded throughout the town, and residents woke up startled.

notes:
FORMATION: Compound verb from ⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧ (to ring/sound) + ⟦{響|ひび}く→響く：00099_hibiku⟧ (to echo). Emphasizes both the production and spread of sound.

TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). Takes ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ particle: ⟦{鐘|かね}→鐘：02654_kane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鳴|な}り{響|ひび}く.

CONJUGATION: Godan verb (ka-row): {鳴|な}り{響|ひび}かない, {鳴|な}り{響|ひび}きます, {鳴|な}り{響|ひび}いて.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{鐘|かね}→鐘：02654_kane⟧/⟦{鈴|すず}→鈴：03890_suzu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鳴|な}り{響|ひび}く (bell rings out)
- ⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧/⟦{歓声|かんせい}→歓声：02686_kansei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鳴|な}り{響|ひび}く (applause/cheers resound)
- ⟦サイレン→サイレン：26994_sairen⟧/⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鳴|な}り{響|ひび}く (siren/alarm blares)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{響|ひび}く→響く：00099_hibiku⟧ (to echo, resound)
- ⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧ (to ring, sound)
- {轟|とどろ}く (to roar, thunder - for louder sounds)
